title: 第5章 暴食第6章 执医证考试
slug: 我金丹呢你当结石摘出来了
lines: 苏业睁开眼，便是从未有过的饥饿感，身体的每一个细胞都在抗议，他的精神澎湃，能够清晰的感受到自己的血肉仿佛一座肉山上的肉芽，那些肉芽争先恐后的睁开嘴巴，大吼，让苏业震了一下，他的第一反应是看手机。
屏幕亮起来的瞬间，他愣住了。
“我竟然一口气睡了整整二十五个小时。”
苏业坐起身，脑子里还有点懵。他这辈子加上辈子，从来没有一觉睡这么久过，但身体的反馈很诚实，二十五个小时的深度睡眠之后，之前的虚弱感消退了大半，精神也饱满的很。
他轻轻摸了一下左腰，深处，金丹雏形的存在感比昨天更清晰了，脉动更稳，凉意更柔和，像是一颗种子在土壤里扎稳了根。
镜子里的自己看起来还是有些憔悴，嘴唇干裂，眼窝微微凹陷，但气色比前天好了不少。
简单洗了把脸刷了个牙，换上衣服快步下楼。
楼下拐角处有一家开了十几年的早餐店，原主是这里的常客，老板姓刘，五十来岁，胖墩墩的，围裙上永远沾着油渍，人很热络。
苏业走进去的时候，店里还没什么人，刘老板正在后厨忙活，听到动静探头一看。
“刘叔，来两笼小笼包，一碗豆腐脑，两根油条，一碗粥。”
两分钟后，小笼包端上来了。
他夹起一个塞进嘴里，烫得龇牙，但顾不上了，一口一个，两笼二十个小笼包，不到三分钟全部下肚。
苏业愣了一下，然后抬手招呼刘老板。
“刘叔，再来两笼小笼包，一份炒面，一份炒饭，两个茶叶蛋，再来一碗豆浆。”
刘老板从后厨探出头，表情有点奇怪。
content_en:
[Prototype of water type golden elixir·Spiritual type]
[Fusion progress: 38%]
[There are still about 45 hours until complete integration]
"So hungry."
When Su ye opened his eyes, he felt hungry as he had never felt before. Every cell in his body was protesting. His energy was surging, and he could clearly feel that his flesh and blood were like granules on a mountain of flesh. Those granules rushed to open their mouths and roared, which shocked Su ye. His first reaction was to look at his phone.
The moment the screen lit up, he was stunned.
"I actually slept for twenty-five hours in one breath."
Su ye sat up, still a little confused. He had never slept for so long in his entire life, but his body's feedback was very honest. After twenty-five hours of deep sleep, most of the previous weakness had subsided, and he felt very full of energy.
He gently touched his left waist. Deep down, the existence of the prototype of the golden elixir was clearer than yesterday. The pulse was steadier and the coolness was softer, like a seed taking root firmly in the soil.
I still look a little haggard in the mirror, with chapped lips and slightly sunken eye sockets, but my complexion is much better than the day before yesterday.
His stomach twisted again.
Hungry.
Really hungry.
I simply washed my face and brushed my teeth, put on my clothes and hurried downstairs.
…
There is a breakfast shop on the corner downstairs that has been open for more than ten years. The original owner is a regular customer here. The boss's surname is Liu. He is in his fifties, chubby, and his apron is always stained with oil. He is very warm.
When Su ye walked in, there was no one in the store. Boss Liu was busy in the kitchen when he heard some noise and looked over.
"Hey, Xiao Su, is it so early today?"
"Uncle Liu, please bring two small steamed buns, a bowl of tofu puffs, two fried dough sticks, and a bowl of porridge."
"Okay!"
Su ye found a corner and sat down.
Two minutes later, the xiaolongbao arrived.
He picked one up and stuffed it into his mouth. His teeth were grimacing because of the heat, but he didn't care. He took one bite at a time, two baskets of twenty dumplings, and ate them all in less than three minutes.
Gudong, gudong.
Then he put down the bowl.
Still hungry.
Su ye was stunned for a moment, then raised his hand to greet Boss Liu.
"Uncle Liu, two more steamed buns, one fried noodles, one fried rice, two tea eggs, and a bowl of soy milk."
Boss Liu poked his head out of the kitchen with a strange expression.
"Still eating?"
"Well, I'm very hungry today."
"Okay."
